text:
Noah Rivera: Hey team, first-day issue. Kandji shows 'Enrollment failed: SCEP timeout' and the device profile never appears. I'm in a coworking space using their managed proxy (PAC). Also noticed `fdesetup status` returns 'FileVault is Off'. Don't have sudo yet.

Ivy Park: Welcome Noah! HR should have sent the e-sign. The PAC/proxy often blocks SCEP to our CA. Can you try signing DocuSign first so we can grant a short temp-admin? Which network exactly (provider name)?

Noah Rivera: Signed the e-sign. Network is "NextHub Coworking" using a proxy at proxy.nexthub.local:8080 (auto-config).

IT Bot: Ticket #RD-ONB-7019 created and assigned to Ivy Park.

Ivy Park: I'll grant 90-min temp sudo so you can (1) install our root CA, (2) set an explicit proxy env to bypass PAC for the CA host, and (3) re-trigger Kandji. Temp token will auto-revoke.

Noah Rivera: Got temp sudo. What exact commands?

Ivy Park: Run these:
```
# download and add root CA
curl -fsS -o /tmp/redwood-root.crt https://pki.redwood.corp/root.crt
sudo security add-trusted-cert -d -r trustRoot -k /Library/Keychains/System.keychain /tmp/redwood-root.crt

# set a direct proxy exception for the CA host and retry enrolment
export no_proxy="pki.redwood.corp"
sudo /usr/local/bin/kandji-agent enroll --retry
```
If the coworking proxy still intercepts TLS, let us know and we'll arrange a short remote session.

Noah Rivera: Ran cert install, 'certificate added'. Tried enroll but kandji-agent errors with 'connect: proxy auth required'.

DevSecOps: Coworking proxies often require NTLM auth. Two quick options: A) tether your phone hotspot for a clean path, or B) we can temporarily remap our CA to a public IP reachable without proxy via a short window. Hotspot is fastest.

Noah Rivera: Switching to phone hotspot now... enroll succeeded! Profile installed and I can see the 802.1X profile.

Ivy Park: Nice. Note you enabled FileVault? (we didn't tell you to)

Noah Rivera: I didn't enable it. Still shows 'Off'. Should I enable now?

Ivy Park: Please wait. Kandji handles escrow and the corporate policy expects the MDM to escrow the recovery key. If you enable manually before MDM sets escrow, we might not capture the key. We'll trigger the machine SSE profile that enables FileVault automatically once the device is fully enrolled. I'll mark the ticket.

DevSecOps: Also you'll get a System Extension prompt for our VPN (allowed via Kandji). If it asks, screenshot it and ping us so we can approve via policy instead of granting persistent admin.

Noah Rivera: Got it. VPN extension prompt appeared but I didn't approve. All set otherwise, Docker in Codespaces works. Thanks for the help! :wave:
